problems.problem: The brief's 'two soft felt discs layered like muted moons' still does not read: outer ellipse (x128,y168,800x800) and inner ellipse (x330,y268,520x512) put the inner center only ~62px right / ~44px up of the outer center, so in the render the inner disc shows only as a thin lighter crescent at the right rim (x~700-850) while the left, top and bottom edges of the two discs sit 60-100px apart in a near-concentric ring. The watch silhouette (bbox 288,202-792,951) then cuts the crescent at 2 o'clock and 7 o'clock with no deliberate offset rhythm, so the hero sits in a bullseye rather than layered depth.

The promised 'broad soft illumination from the upper left with velvet darkening to lower right' is still too weak to anchor the metal: the felt nap noise is near-uniform corner to corner and the only readable gradient is the disc stack, so the silver case (whose highlights come from the original upper-front-left key) sits in a field with no matching directional wash. References 4-5 each tie product light to scene light with a visible pool or falloff; this draft's field remains a flat wallpaper behind a pasted cutout.

Against references 3-5 the poster still lacks one supporting light story: ref 4's radial pool and ref 5's graded ground both echo the key direction on the metal, while here the disc edges are hard vector circles with uniform value inside, so the metal's specular gradient (bright bezel upper-left, dark lower-right strap) has no environmental counterpart and the hero reads one lighting stop cooler than its setting.

The anchored column is improved (subtitle now 47px below the title block, rule trimmed to 210px) but still not one measure: logo block is 115px wide, rule 210px, subtitle 154px, title 490px, so four different widths stack in the left column; the 210px rule now overhangs the 115px logo by ~1.8x and stops mid-air with no alignment to either the subtitle cap width or the title measure, leaving the brand block visually unruled.

changes.value: Deep aubergine pressed wool felt panel, dense matte fibre nap, one broad soft light pool entering from the upper left corner and dissolving diagonally into velvet darkness at the lower right corner and edges, fibre tips catching the diagonal gradient, completely empty flat field with no objects
